title: 軟土潛盾開挖面穩定分析~Face-stability analysis for soft-ground shields
focus: 以土水作用、支護壓力梯度與失土證據界定軟土開挖面模型~Bound soft-ground face models using soil-water interaction, pressure gradients and ground-loss evidence
summary: 本課聚焦以土水作用、支護壓力梯度與失土證據界定軟土開挖面模型。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。~This course focuses on bound soft-ground face models using soil-water interaction, pressure gradients and ground-loss evidence. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.

units.anchor: 總應力與有效應力~Total and effective stress
units.title: 總應力與有效應力~Total and effective stress
units.mechanism: 軟土開挖面受骨架應力與孔隙水共同作用，短期不排水黏土和排水砂土需要不同強度描述。把土水壓力合併成單一數值再任意扣減，容易重複計入或遺漏孔壓。 假設總法向應力300 kPa、孔壓180 kPa，有效應力120 kPa；這只是應力分解，不是支護壓力設定。 將不排水強度與排水摩擦角混在同一破壞面會失去物理一致，重複扣孔壓則低估有效約束；算式看似完整卻不能支援可靠穩定判斷。~Face loading combines skeleton stress and pore water. Short-term undrained clay and drained sand require different strength descriptions; merging everything into one pressure and then subtracting arbitrarily can double-count or omit water effects. Assumed total normal stress 300 kPa and pore pressure 180 kPa give effective stress 120 kPa; this is decomposition, not a support-pressure setting. Mixing undrained strength with drained friction on one failure surface breaks physical consistency. Subtracting pressure twice underestimates confinement, leaving a complete-looking calculation without a defensible stability interpretation.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設總法向應力300 kPa、孔壓180 kPa，有效應力120 kPa；這只是應力分解，不是支護壓力設定。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed total normal stress 300 kPa and pore pressure 180 kPa give effective stress 120 kPa; this is decomposition, not a support-pressure setting.
units.verify: 以分層地質、地下水與試驗排水條件建立參數表，將模型採總應力或有效應力明確標示；設計審查逐項追查水壓是否只計一次，並用合理水位範圍測敏感度。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：將不排水強度與排水摩擦角混在同一破壞面會失去物理一致，重複扣孔壓則低估有效約束；算式看似完整卻不能支援可靠穩定判斷。~Build parameter tables from stratigraphy, groundwater and drainage conditions, explicitly labeling total- or effective-stress analysis; review water accounting to ensure it appears once and test a plausible groundwater range. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Mixing undrained strength with drained friction on one failure surface breaks physical consistency. Subtracting pressure twice underestimates confinement, leaving a complete-looking calculation without a defensible stability interpretation.
units.failure: 將不排水強度與排水摩擦角混在同一破壞面會失去物理一致，重複扣孔壓則低估有效約束；算式看似完整卻不能支援可靠穩定判斷。~Mixing undrained strength with drained friction on one failure surface breaks physical consistency. Subtracting pressure twice underestimates confinement, leaving a complete-looking calculation without a defensible stability interpretation.
units.misconception: 不排水強度和排水摩擦角可不分條件地混在同一模型。~Undrained strength and drained friction can be mixed unconditionally in one model.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄總應力與有效應力的資料來源與適用條件。以分層地質、地下水與試驗排水條件建立參數表，將模型採總應力或有效應力明確標示；設計審查逐項追查水壓是否只計一次，並用合理水位範圍測敏感度。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for total and effective stress. Build parameter tables from stratigraphy, groundwater and drainage conditions, explicitly labeling total- or effective-stress analysis; review water accounting to ensure it appears once and test a plausible groundwater range.

units.anchor: 壓力梯度與高度~Pressure gradient with height
units.title: 壓力梯度與高度~Pressure gradient with height
units.mechanism: 倉內支護介質有自重，頂部與底部壓力不同，而地層與水壓梯度也未必相同。只控制單一感測器讀值不能保證全掌子面均衡，必須把所有讀值換算到共同高度再比較分布。 假設介質密度1500 kg/m³、垂直高差6 m，Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa；非整面穩定所需壓差。 以底部壓力代表頂部會高估頂拱支護，密度分層又使線性換算失準；局部失穩可能在平均壓力看似正常時開始，不能只盯總平均。~Support medium has weight, creating different crown and invert pressures, while soil and groundwater gradients may differ. One sensor does not prove full-face balance; readings need a common elevation and a distribution comparison. For assumed medium density 1500 kg/m³ and vertical difference 6 m, Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa; this is not the required stability-pressure range. Using invert pressure for the crown overstates crown support, while density stratification invalidates a linear conversion. Local instability can begin with a normal-looking mean pressure, making averages insufficient.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設介質密度1500 kg/m³、垂直高差6 m，Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa；非整面穩定所需壓差。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed medium density 1500 kg/m³ and vertical difference 6 m, Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa; this is not the required stability-pressure range.
units.verify: 核對壓力計高程、零點與介質密度，將多高度讀值畫成梯度並對照理論；若梯度異常需查分層、氣泡或堵塞，經設計及設備主管評估後才可解讀成地層壓力變化。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：以底部壓力代表頂部會高估頂拱支護，密度分層又使線性換算失準；局部失穩可能在平均壓力看似正常時開始，不能只盯總平均。~Check sensor elevation, zero and medium density, plotting multiheight readings against the expected gradient; investigate segregation, air or blockage before design and equipment leads interpret an anomaly as changing ground pressure. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Using invert pressure for the crown overstates crown support, while density stratification invalidates a linear conversion. Local instability can begin with a normal-looking mean pressure, making averages insufficient.
units.failure: 以底部壓力代表頂部會高估頂拱支護，密度分層又使線性換算失準；局部失穩可能在平均壓力看似正常時開始，不能只盯總平均。~Using invert pressure for the crown overstates crown support, while density stratification invalidates a linear conversion. Local instability can begin with a normal-looking mean pressure, making averages insufficient.
units.misconception: 一個底部壓力計正常就代表整個掌子面支護都足夠。~A normal invert pressure reading proves adequate support over the entire face.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄壓力梯度與高度的資料來源與適用條件。核對壓力計高程、零點與介質密度，將多高度讀值畫成梯度並對照理論；若梯度異常需查分層、氣泡或堵塞，經設計及設備主管評估後才可解讀成地層壓力變化。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for pressure gradient with height. Check sensor elevation, zero and medium density, plotting multiheight readings against the expected gradient; investigate segregation, air or blockage before design and equipment leads interpret an anomaly as changing ground pressure.

units.anchor: 覆土與上舉邊界~Cover and uplift boundaries
units.title: 覆土與上舉邊界~Cover and uplift boundaries
units.mechanism: 支護不足可能造成坍入，過大壓力也可能推動淺覆土上舉或形成逸流。穩定分析需要上下兩側機制而不是只求最低值，鄰近地面荷載與弱層會改變可行範圍。 假設均質覆土重度18 kN/m³、厚8 m，自重應力144 kPa；此量級檢查未計拱效應、黏聚或水。 只提高支護壓力來追求防坍會忽略上舉與地表噴出路徑，薄弱夾層可能先被打通；若未有上限機制分析，控制策略就缺少另一半。~Insufficient support can cause collapse, while excessive pressure may lift shallow cover or create escape paths. Analysis needs both lower and upper mechanisms, with surface loads and weak layers affecting the feasible interval. Assumed uniform cover unit weight 18 kN/m³ over 8 m gives 144 kPa overburden; this scale check excludes arching, cohesion and water. Increasing pressure solely to prevent collapse ignores uplift and surface escape paths, which may open along weak layers. Without an upper-bound mechanism the control concept remains fundamentally incomplete.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設均質覆土重度18 kN/m³、厚8 m，自重應力144 kPa；此量級檢查未計拱效應、黏聚或水。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed uniform cover unit weight 18 kN/m³ over 8 m gives 144 kPa overburden; this scale check excludes arching, cohesion and water.
units.verify: 用地形、建物載重與地下管線資料檢查淺覆土區，並列坍入及上舉情境；設計者須給出場址專屬模型和審查界線，課程自重值不得當機器壓力目標。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只提高支護壓力來追求防坍會忽略上舉與地表噴出路徑，薄弱夾層可能先被打通；若未有上限機制分析，控制策略就缺少另一半。~Check shallow cover against terrain, building loads and utilities and analyze collapse and uplift separately; designers provide site-specific models and review boundaries, and the teaching overburden value is not a machine target. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Increasing pressure solely to prevent collapse ignores uplift and surface escape paths, which may open along weak layers. Without an upper-bound mechanism the control concept remains fundamentally incomplete.
units.failure: 只提高支護壓力來追求防坍會忽略上舉與地表噴出路徑，薄弱夾層可能先被打通；若未有上限機制分析，控制策略就缺少另一半。~Increasing pressure solely to prevent collapse ignores uplift and surface escape paths, which may open along weak layers. Without an upper-bound mechanism the control concept remains fundamentally incomplete.
units.misconception: 支護壓力越高越安全，不必考慮淺覆土上舉。~Higher support pressure is always safer without considering shallow-cover uplift.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄覆土與上舉邊界的資料來源與適用條件。用地形、建物載重與地下管線資料檢查淺覆土區，並列坍入及上舉情境；設計者須給出場址專屬模型和審查界線，課程自重值不得當機器壓力目標。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for cover and uplift boundaries. Check shallow cover against terrain, building loads and utilities and analyze collapse and uplift separately; designers provide site-specific models and review boundaries, and the teaching overburden value is not a machine target.

units.anchor: 不排水穩定比值~Undrained stability index
units.title: 不排水穩定比值~Undrained stability index
units.mechanism: 黏土短期開挖常以不排水強度描述，荷載差除以強度可形成規一化穩定指標。臨界值依幾何、覆土及破壞機制而變，不能從別案搬一個常數就直接設定支護。 假設荷載差150 kPa、su=50 kPa，示意N=150/50=3；此值未提供任何通用合格門檻。 平均強度會掩蓋薄弱層，將重塑強度或完整強度任意替換又改變意義；穩定指標小數位精細也無法補足材料代表性不足。~Short-term clay excavation often uses undrained strength. Dividing a load difference by that strength produces a normalized stability index, but its critical value depends on geometry, cover and failure mechanism rather than one transferable constant. For assumed load difference 150 kPa and su=50 kPa, illustrative N=3; no universal acceptance threshold is implied. Average strength can hide a weak interbed, and substituting remolded for intact strength changes the meaning. Fine decimal precision in a stability index cannot compensate for unrepresentative material data.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設荷載差150 kPa、su=50 kPa，示意N=150/50=3；此值未提供任何通用合格門檻。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed load difference 150 kPa and su=50 kPa, illustrative N=3; no universal acceptance threshold is implied.
units.verify: 由代表性取樣與應變速率資料建立su範圍，檢查軟層是否控制整個面；使用適合斷面與覆土的分析並比較敏感度，只有專業設計審查可決定實際控制界線。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：平均強度會掩蓋薄弱層，將重塑強度或完整強度任意替換又改變意義；穩定指標小數位精細也無法補足材料代表性不足。~Establish a representative su range with strain-rate context and identify controlling weak layers; use analysis matching geometry and cover and compare sensitivity, leaving actual control boundaries to professional design review. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Average strength can hide a weak interbed, and substituting remolded for intact strength changes the meaning. Fine decimal precision in a stability index cannot compensate for unrepresentative material data.
units.failure: 平均強度會掩蓋薄弱層，將重塑強度或完整強度任意替換又改變意義；穩定指標小數位精細也無法補足材料代表性不足。~Average strength can hide a weak interbed, and substituting remolded for intact strength changes the meaning. Fine decimal precision in a stability index cannot compensate for unrepresentative material data.
units.misconception: 某工程的臨界穩定指標可以不看幾何直接搬到另一工程。~A critical stability index transfers between projects without considering geometry.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄不排水穩定比值的資料來源與適用條件。由代表性取樣與應變速率資料建立su範圍，檢查軟層是否控制整個面；使用適合斷面與覆土的分析並比較敏感度，只有專業設計審查可決定實際控制界線。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for undrained stability index. Establish a representative su range with strain-rate context and identify controlling weak layers; use analysis matching geometry and cover and compare sensitivity, leaving actual control boundaries to professional design review.

units.anchor: 砂土滲流與濾膜~Sand seepage and filter cake
units.title: 砂土滲流與濾膜~Sand seepage and filter cake
units.mechanism: 砂土中支護壓力需透過介質與土體界面傳遞，滲透太深時壓力作用範圍和有效應力路徑會改變。泥膜不是抽象的完美邊界，粒徑、滲透性和介質特性共同控制壓力傳遞。 假設孔隙比e=0.7、Gs=2.65，理想向上滲流臨界梯度ic=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=0.971；非掌子面設計門檻。 若假設完整泥膜卻實際深度滲入，名義倉壓不等於有效支護，出現細砂流失仍可能被忽略；濾膜破裂也會使原本穩定的壓力傳遞突然改變。~In sand, support pressure transfers through the medium-ground interface. Deep infiltration changes the loaded region and effective-stress path. A filter cake is not a perfect abstract boundary; grading, permeability and medium behavior govern transfer. Assume void ratio e=0.7 and Gs=2.65; ideal upward-seepage critical gradient ic=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=0.971, not a face-design threshold. Assuming an intact cake during deep infiltration equates chamber pressure with effective support incorrectly. Fine-sand loss may be missed, and cake rupture can abruptly change a previously stable transfer mechanism.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設孔隙比e=0.7、Gs=2.65，理想向上滲流臨界梯度ic=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=0.971；非掌子面設計門檻。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume void ratio e=0.7 and Gs=2.65; ideal upward-seepage critical gradient ic=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=0.971, not a face-design threshold.
units.verify: 以代表性砂樣做合格試驗比較滲透與濾膜形成，記錄壓差、滲流及顆粒流失；工程師需確認試驗方向、尺度與現場相符，不把一維向上滲流公式直接套到三維掌子面。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：若假設完整泥膜卻實際深度滲入，名義倉壓不等於有效支護，出現細砂流失仍可能被忽略；濾膜破裂也會使原本穩定的壓力傳遞突然改變。~Test representative sand for infiltration and filter formation with pressure, flow and particle-loss records; engineers verify direction and scale, avoiding direct transfer of a one-dimensional upward-flow relation to a three-dimensional face. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Assuming an intact cake during deep infiltration equates chamber pressure with effective support incorrectly. Fine-sand loss may be missed, and cake rupture can abruptly change a previously stable transfer mechanism.
units.failure: 若假設完整泥膜卻實際深度滲入，名義倉壓不等於有效支護，出現細砂流失仍可能被忽略；濾膜破裂也會使原本穩定的壓力傳遞突然改變。~Assuming an intact cake during deep infiltration equates chamber pressure with effective support incorrectly. Fine-sand loss may be missed, and cake rupture can abruptly change a previously stable transfer mechanism.
units.misconception: 只要土倉壓力正常，就可假設泥膜永遠完整不透水。~Normal chamber pressure permits assuming an eternally intact impermeable filter cake.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄砂土滲流與濾膜的資料來源與適用條件。以代表性砂樣做合格試驗比較滲透與濾膜形成，記錄壓差、滲流及顆粒流失；工程師需確認試驗方向、尺度與現場相符，不把一維向上滲流公式直接套到三維掌子面。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for sand seepage and filter cake. Test representative sand for infiltration and filter formation with pressure, flow and particle-loss records; engineers verify direction and scale, avoiding direct transfer of a one-dimensional upward-flow relation to a three-dimensional face.

units.anchor: 體積平衡與失土~Volume balance and ground loss
units.title: 體積平衡與失土~Volume balance and ground loss
units.mechanism: 開挖體積、出土量與倉內儲量構成收支，但出土含水與改良材料會使重量和體積不直接可比。短暫收支差可能是儲量變化，持續差異才需結合沉陷與壓力評估失土。 假設直徑6 m、前進1.5 m，理論體積πD²L/4=42.41 m³；出土差額須先校正添加量與鬆脹。 把濕土重量增加當成超挖會誤調控制，反之漏計螺旋機持續出土可能掩蓋倉內減量；資料時間不同步則會製造假的短時失土。~Excavated volume, discharge and chamber storage form a balance, but water and conditioning change mass-volume conversion. Temporary imbalance can reflect storage; persistent discrepancies require pressure and settlement evidence before interpreting ground loss. Assume diameter 6 m and advance 1.5 m; theoretical volume πD²L/4=42.41 m³, with discharge differences corrected for additions and bulking first. Mistaking increased wet mass for overexcavation prompts wrong adjustments, while uncounted continued discharge hides chamber depletion. Unsynchronized records can manufacture an apparent short-term ground-loss event.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設直徑6 m、前進1.5 m，理論體積πD²L/4=42.41 m³；出土差額須先校正添加量與鬆脹。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume diameter 6 m and advance 1.5 m; theoretical volume πD²L/4=42.41 m³, with discharge differences corrected for additions and bulking first.
units.verify: 同步行程、重量、含水率與添加材料紀錄，將出土量換成同一乾土或原位體積基準；比較倉壓和地表監測，未閉合收支由設備與地工人員共同查因，不能只用單環百分比判定。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把濕土重量增加當成超挖會誤調控制，反之漏計螺旋機持續出土可能掩蓋倉內減量；資料時間不同步則會製造假的短時失土。~Synchronize advance, mass, moisture and additions and convert discharge to a common dry-soil or in-situ basis; compare pressure and settlement and jointly investigate imbalance rather than judging one ring percentage alone. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Mistaking increased wet mass for overexcavation prompts wrong adjustments, while uncounted continued discharge hides chamber depletion. Unsynchronized records can manufacture an apparent short-term ground-loss event.
units.failure: 把濕土重量增加當成超挖會誤調控制，反之漏計螺旋機持續出土可能掩蓋倉內減量；資料時間不同步則會製造假的短時失土。~Mistaking increased wet mass for overexcavation prompts wrong adjustments, while uncounted continued discharge hides chamber depletion. Unsynchronized records can manufacture an apparent short-term ground-loss event.
units.misconception: 濕出土重量增加就必定代表原位土被過量開挖。~Greater wet discharge mass necessarily means excessive excavation of in-situ soil.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄體積平衡與失土的資料來源與適用條件。同步行程、重量、含水率與添加材料紀錄，將出土量換成同一乾土或原位體積基準；比較倉壓和地表監測，未閉合收支由設備與地工人員共同查因，不能只用單環百分比判定。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for volume balance and ground loss. Synchronize advance, mass, moisture and additions and convert discharge to a common dry-soil or in-situ basis; compare pressure and settlement and jointly investigate imbalance rather than judging one ring percentage alone.

units.anchor: 停機與壓力演變~Standstill and pressure evolution
units.title: 停機與壓力演變~Standstill and pressure evolution
units.mechanism: 停機後土倉和地層仍會排水、固結或滲漏，壓力不一定維持推進時的分布。土壤改良物性也隨時間改變，因此停機情境需獨立分析，不能把推進穩態直接延長。 假設教學一階衰減p(t)=p0e^(−t/τ)，p0=200 kPa、τ=10 h，2 h後163.7 kPa；非現場預測。 只監看平均倉壓會漏掉分層或局部氣穴，長停機後介質失去可塑性也可能造成壓力傳遞不均；重新推進時風險不再等同停止前。~After stopping, drainage, consolidation and leakage continue and alter pressure distribution. Conditioning properties also age, so standstill requires a separate scenario rather than indefinite extension of the advancing steady state. For an assumed teaching decay p(t)=p0e^(−t/τ), p0=200 kPa and τ=10 h give 163.7 kPa after 2 h; this is not a field prediction. Average pressure can hide stratification or local voids, while aged material loses plasticity and transfers load unevenly. Restart conditions therefore need not resemble the state immediately before stopping.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設教學一階衰減p(t)=p0e^(−t/τ)，p0=200 kPa、τ=10 h，2 h後163.7 kPa；非現場預測。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed teaching decay p(t)=p0e^(−t/τ), p0=200 kPa and τ=10 h give 163.7 kPa after 2 h; this is not a field prediction.
units.verify: 比較停機前後多高度壓力、出入量和地下水條件，記錄每次停機原因及持續時間；任何需重新建立支護的處置依核准程序與專業人員執行，算例衰減常數不能當現場等待時間。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只監看平均倉壓會漏掉分層或局部氣穴，長停機後介質失去可塑性也可能造成壓力傳遞不均；重新推進時風險不再等同停止前。~Compare multiheight pressures, inflow-outflow and groundwater before and during stops, recording cause and duration; restoring support follows approved specialist procedures, and the illustrative time constant is not a permissible waiting period. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Average pressure can hide stratification or local voids, while aged material loses plasticity and transfers load unevenly. Restart conditions therefore need not resemble the state immediately before stopping.

units.misconception: 停止推進後土倉壓力和改良土性質會永遠保持不變。~Chamber pressure and conditioned-soil properties remain unchanged forever after advance stops.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄停機與壓力演變的資料來源與適用條件。比較停機前後多高度壓力、出入量和地下水條件，記錄每次停機原因及持續時間；任何需重新建立支護的處置依核准程序與專業人員執行，算例衰減常數不能當現場等待時間。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for standstill and pressure evolution. Compare multiheight pressures, inflow-outflow and groundwater before and during stops, recording cause and duration; restoring support follows approved specialist procedures, and the illustrative time constant is not a permissible waiting period.

units.anchor: 混合地層與面內差異~Mixed ground across the face
units.title: 混合地層與面內差異~Mixed ground across the face
units.mechanism: 掌子面同時遇到砂、黏土或硬軟界面時，各區滲透、強度與切削阻力不同。單一平均參數會抹去最不利局部機制，且刀盤擾動可能使原本隔離的水路連通。 假設面積30 m²中6 m²為高透水砂，比例20%；面積小不代表其對滲流風險只貢獻20%。 薄砂層可能主導水土流失而被平均黏土參數掩蓋，硬塊又會造成局部擾動；若只因整體倉壓正常便忽略異常出土，可能錯過局部失穩。~A face crossing sand, clay or a hard-soft interface contains contrasting permeability, strength and cutting resistance. Average parameters conceal adverse local mechanisms, and cutter disturbance can connect previously separated water pathways. If an assumed 30 m² face contains 6 m² permeable sand, its area fraction is 20%; its seepage-risk contribution is not necessarily only 20%. A thin sand layer can dominate erosion despite clay-dominated averages, while hard inclusions disturb the face locally. Normal mean chamber pressure does not justify ignoring anomalous discharge indicating localized instability.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設面積30 m²中6 m²為高透水砂，比例20%；面積小不代表其對滲流風險只貢獻20%。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If an assumed 30 m² face contains 6 m² permeable sand, its area fraction is 20%; its seepage-risk contribution is not necessarily only 20%.
units.verify: 利用超前孔與地質剖面估計界面位置範圍，將面內不同區域分開分析並比對扭矩、壓力及出土變化；只在證據支持下更新混合面模型，不以平均土樣取代局部砂層。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：薄砂層可能主導水土流失而被平均黏土參數掩蓋，硬塊又會造成局部擾動；若只因整體倉壓正常便忽略異常出土，可能錯過局部失穩。~Use probing and sections to bound interface position and analyze face regions separately against torque, pressure and discharge; update mixed-face models only with evidence and do not replace a local sand layer with an average sample. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A thin sand layer can dominate erosion despite clay-dominated averages, while hard inclusions disturb the face locally. Normal mean chamber pressure does not justify ignoring anomalous discharge indicating localized instability.

Normal mean chamber pressure does not justify ignoring anomalous discharge indicating localized instability.
units.misconception: 高透水砂只占小面積，就一定只造成同等比例風險。~A small permeable sand area necessarily contributes only that proportional share of risk.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄混合地層與面內差異的資料來源與適用條件。利用超前孔與地質剖面估計界面位置範圍，將面內不同區域分開分析並比對扭矩、壓力及出土變化；只在證據支持下更新混合面模型，不以平均土樣取代局部砂層。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for mixed ground across the face. Use probing and sections to bound interface position and analyze face regions separately against torque, pressure and discharge; update mixed-face models only with evidence and do not replace a local sand layer with an average sample.

units.anchor: 模型敏感度與可靠性~Model sensitivity and reliability
units.title: 模型敏感度與可靠性~Model sensitivity and reliability
units.mechanism: 面穩定結果受土強度、水位與覆土等輸入共同影響，最敏感參數不一定是變異最大的參數。應將物理模型誤差與量測不確定分開，不用單一名義計算掩蓋不利組合。 假設示意指標N=150/su，su由50降40 kPa時N由3增至3.75，增加25%；不是失敗機率。 獨立亂抽實際相關參數可能製造不可能的情境或漏掉共同不利狀態，把敏感度當機率又會給出虛假的可靠度，誤導支護與監測資源配置。~Face-stability results depend on strength, water and cover jointly. The most sensitive parameter need not be the most variable. Separate model error from measurement uncertainty and examine adverse combinations rather than one nominal calculation. For assumed illustrative N=150/su, lowering su from 50 to 40 kPa increases N from 3 to 3.75, or 25%; this is not a failure probability. Independently sampling correlated parameters creates impossible combinations or misses jointly adverse states. Treating sensitivity as probability invents numerical reliability and misdirects support and monitoring resources.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設示意指標N=150/su，su由50降40 kPa時N由3增至3.75，增加25%；不是失敗機率。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed illustrative N=150/su, lowering su from 50 to 40 kPa increases N from 3 to 3.75, or 25%; this is not a failure probability.
units.verify: 針對地質資料支持的上下限做組合分析，記錄參數相關性與模型適用範圍；設計審查應說明哪一種新調查最能縮小決策不確定性，而非只列很多沒有物理依據的模擬案例。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：獨立亂抽實際相關參數可能製造不可能的情境或漏掉共同不利狀態，把敏感度當機率又會給出虛假的可靠度，誤導支護與監測資源配置。~Analyze combinations supported by geological bounds with documented correlations and model scope; review which additional investigation most reduces decision uncertainty rather than listing many simulations without physical justification. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Independently sampling correlated parameters creates impossible combinations or misses jointly adverse states. Treating sensitivity as probability invents numerical reliability and misdirects support and monitoring resources.
units.failure: 獨立亂抽實際相關參數可能製造不可能的情境或漏掉共同不利狀態，把敏感度當機率又會給出虛假的可靠度，誤導支護與監測資源配置。~Independently sampling correlated parameters creates impossible combinations or misses jointly adverse states. Treating sensitivity as probability invents numerical reliability and misdirects support and monitoring resources.
units.misconception: 敏感度分析算出的百分比就是實際失敗機率。~A percentage from sensitivity analysis is the actual probability of failure.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄模型敏感度與可靠性的資料來源與適用條件。針對地質資料支持的上下限做組合分析，記錄參數相關性與模型適用範圍；設計審查應說明哪一種新調查最能縮小決策不確定性，而非只列很多沒有物理依據的模擬案例。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for model sensitivity and reliability. Analyze combinations supported by geological bounds with documented correlations and model scope; review which additional investigation most reduces decision uncertainty rather than listing many simulations without physical justification.

units.anchor: 證據整合與審查界線~Evidence integration and review boundaries
units.title: 證據整合與審查界線~Evidence integration and review boundaries
units.mechanism: 面穩定不能僅由倉壓正常判定，還需出土、沉陷、地質與設備狀態相互支持。控制文件應指出哪種偏離會使模型失效及誰負責審查，讓學徒理解數學結果與操作授權之間的界線。 假設5類證據中4類正常、1類持續異常，正常比例80%；不得以多數決取消異常的獨立調查。 多數訊號正常可能只是共享同一失效感測器或延遲資料，若把異常當離群刪除，最早的局部失穩證據會消失；報告必須保留不一致與處置。~Normal chamber pressure alone does not establish stability; discharge, settlement, geology and equipment condition must agree. Control documents identify deviations invalidating the model and responsible reviewers, separating mathematical interpretation from operational authorization. If 4 of an assumed 5 evidence streams appear normal and 1 remains abnormal, 80% normality cannot overrule independent investigation of the anomaly. Several normal indicators may share a failed sensor or delayed data. Deleting the dissenting signal as an outlier can erase the earliest localized-instability evidence, so discrepancies and responses must remain recorded.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設5類證據中4類正常、1類持續異常，正常比例80%；不得以多數決取消異常的獨立調查。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 4 of an assumed 5 evidence streams appear normal and 1 remains abnormal, 80% normality cannot overrule independent investigation of the anomaly.
units.verify: 以案例演練壓力正常但出土或沉陷異常的情境，核對通知、獨立確認與責任分工；實際機器參數、停機和復工均依核准工程計畫，課程模型只支援判讀而不發出操作指令。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：多數訊號正常可能只是共享同一失效感測器或延遲資料，若把異常當離群刪除，最早的局部失穩證據會消失；報告必須保留不一致與處置。~Rehearse cases with normal pressure but abnormal discharge or movement, checking notification, independent confirmation and responsibility; machine settings, stopping and restart remain under an approved engineering plan rather than course-generated commands. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Several normal indicators may share a failed sensor or delayed data. Deleting the dissenting signal as an outlier can erase the earliest localized-instability evidence, so discrepancies and responses must remain recorded.
units.failure: 多數訊號正常可能只是共享同一失效感測器或延遲資料，若把異常當離群刪除，最早的局部失穩證據會消失；報告必須保留不一致與處置。~Several normal indicators may share a failed sensor or delayed data. Deleting the dissenting signal as an outlier can erase the earliest localized-instability evidence, so discrepancies and responses must remain recorded.
units.misconception: 多數訊號正常時可以直接刪除少數異常當作離群值。~When most signals are normal, the remaining anomalies may simply be deleted as outliers.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄證據整合與審查界線的資料來源與適用條件。以案例演練壓力正常但出土或沉陷異常的情境，核對通知、獨立確認與責任分工；實際機器參數、停機和復工均依核准工程計畫，課程模型只支援判讀而不發出操作指令。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for evidence integration and review boundaries. Rehearse cases with normal pressure but abnormal discharge or movement, checking notification, independent confirmation and responsibility; machine settings, stopping and restart remain under an approved engineering plan rather than course-generated commands.

example: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設總法向應力300 kPa、孔壓180 kPa，有效應力120 kPa；這只是應力分解，不是支護壓力設定。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設介質密度1500 kg/m³、垂直高差6 m，Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa；非整面穩定所需壓差。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。~Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed total normal stress 300 kPa and pore pressure 180 kPa give effective stress 120 kPa; this is decomposition, not a support-pressure setting. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed medium density 1500 kg/m³ and vertical difference 6 m, Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa; this is not the required stability-pressure range. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
history: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示以土水作用、支護壓力梯度與失土證據界定軟土開挖面模型需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。~FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why bound soft-ground face models using soil-water interaction, pressure gradients and ground-loss evidence requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.
facts: 教學量化備忘：假設總法向應力300 kPa、孔壓180 kPa，有效應力120 kPa；這只是應力分解，不是支護壓力設定。~Teaching quantitative note: Assumed total normal stress 300 kPa and pore pressure 180 kPa give effective stress 120 kPa; this is decomposition, not a support-pressure setting.

教學量化備忘：假設介質密度1500 kg/m³、垂直高差6 m，Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa；非整面穩定所需壓差。~Teaching quantitative note: For assumed medium density 1500 kg/m³ and vertical difference 6 m, Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa; this is not the required stability-pressure range.

教學量化備忘：假設均質覆土重度18 kN/m³、厚8 m，自重應力144 kPa；此量級檢查未計拱效應、黏聚或水。~Teaching quantitative note: Assumed uniform cover unit weight 18 kN/m³ over 8 m gives 144 kPa overburden; this scale check excludes arching, cohesion and water.

教學量化備忘：假設荷載差150 kPa、su=50 kPa，示意N=150/50=3；此值未提供任何通用合格門檻。~Teaching quantitative note: For assumed load difference 150 kPa and su=50 kPa, illustrative N=3; no universal acceptance threshold is implied.

教學量化備忘：假設孔隙比e=0.7、Gs=2.65，理想向上滲流臨界梯度ic=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=0.971；非掌子面設計門檻。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume void ratio e=0.7 and Gs=2.65; ideal upward-seepage critical gradient ic=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=0.971, not a face-design threshold.

教學量化備忘：假設直徑6 m、前進1.5 m，理論體積πD²L/4=42.41 m³；出土差額須先校正添加量與鬆脹。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume diameter 6 m and advance 1.5 m; theoretical volume πD²L/4=42.41 m³, with discharge differences corrected for additions and bulking first.
